symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the fixed space from which the subspace labels are drawn, which counts the vectors in a basis of that space.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the dimension of the fixed space from which the labels are drawn.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls made by one call, which counts the calls on streams of smaller volume.
symbols.quote: Here $s$ is the total number of smaller calls made by one call.

symbols.name: volume shrink factor
symbols.meaning: The factor by which the stream volume shrinks in each smaller call.
symbols.quote: Here $q$ is the factor by which the stream volume shrinks, so each smaller call works on a stream of $1/q$ of the volume.

relations.quote: The network attaches [subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) to its gates and terminals.
The network is based on [linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md), so its wires carry scalars and its gates combine them.
